newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine cement firm eyes stake in Zeus.
newsitem.headline: Philippine cement firm eyes stake in Zeus.

text.p: Philippines' Far East Cement Corp Group had agreed to buy into recently-converted holding company Zeus Holdings Inc, Zeus said on Wednesday.
Zeus said Far East, upon the invitation of Zeus, would transfer its interest in Mindanao Portland Cement Corp (MPCC) and its assets into Zeus.
"Any final agreement on the matter will be subject to a satisfactory due diligence of MPCC which is to be completed within 60 days," the company said in a statement.
The terms of the transaction will be based on the net asset value of Mindanao Portland assets.
